item.title: Fundraiser Spotlight: Honouring Owen & Jack - turning loss into action. - iDonate.ie
item.description: We love to highlight fundraisers that embody the true spirit of community, remembrance, and impact - and this one is truly special. A group of fourteen former classmates from Clongowes Wood College (Class of 2007) are taking on the Stockholm Marathon on May 31st in memory of their dear friends, Owen Lochrin and Jack Lidholm, who sadly passed away last year.

item.title: How-To: Support a Family in Need - iDonate.ie
item.description: When a family is facing a crisis - it’s only natural to want to help. Fundraising through iDonate.ie is one of the most impactful ways to show support. Here’s how you can get started and make a real difference.

item.title: iDonate Surpasses €2.2 Million Raised Through the 2025 Vhi Women’s Mini Marathon. - iDonate.ie
item.description: We’re thrilled to announce that over €2.2 million has already been raised through iDonate, Official Fundraising Partner for the 2025 Vhi Women’s Mini Marathon! But the story doesn’t end at the finish line, donations are still open, and there’s still time to show your support.💜

item.title: €6 Million Raised in May 2025. A Record-Breaking Month! - iDonate.ie
item.description: We’re thrilled to announce that over €6 million was raised through our platform in May 2025 a new monthly fundraising record that reflects the generosity, passion, and commitment of communities across Ireland. Powered by amazing events and thousands of individual fundraisers, this remarkable total showcases the growing impact of digital fundraising for good causes.

item.title: Ring of Kerry Charity Cycle 2025 🚴 - iDonate.ie
item.description: We are thrilled to celebrate another phenomenal year of the Ring of Kerry Charity Cycle, which took place on Saturday, July 5th, 2025. As the official fundraising partner, iDonate.ie is incredibly proud to have supported thousands of amazing cyclists, charities, and supporters in what has become one of Ireland’s most beloved charity events.

item.title: Making Waves for a Great Cause: Galway Bay Swim 2025 🌊💙 - iDonate.ie
item.description: On Saturday July 19th, a group of courageous swimmers took on one of Ireland’s toughest open water challenges, a 13km swim across Galway Bay all in support of Cancer Care West. The event fundraised 17% more compared to 2024, with the percentage of fundraising pages with donations up +7%. Here's how it happened!

item.title: Hell & Back - Official Fundraising Partner - iDonate.ie
item.description: We’re delighted to announce that iDonate is the Official Fundraising Partner for HELL & BACK, Ireland’s toughest physical and mental endurance challenge! This exciting partnership means that every participant can now tackle the mud, the walls, and the obstacles – all while raising vital funds for the charity they care about most.

item.title: Festive Fundraising Tools: Christmas Jumper Day & Christmas Raffles - iDonate.ie
item.description: As the festive season approaches, charities, schools, clubs, and corporates are planning Christmas fundraisers. In 2025, two favourites remain unbeatable: Christmas Jumper Day and Christmas Raffles.

item.title: Ireland Dives In for Breast Cancer Research! Swim in Pink 2025 Sets New Records 🌊💖 - iDonate.ie
item.description: Ireland made a big splash this year for breast cancer research! The 2025 Swim in Pink in support of the National Breast Cancer Research Institute (NBCRI) has raised an incredible €317,114 (and counting!) on iDonate.ie - marking a 58.5% increase on 2024’s total

item.title: iDonate Achieves ISO 27001 Certification. - iDonate.ie
item.description: iDonate achieves ISO 27001 certification strengthening security and trust for our charity partners. This milestone represents months of detailed work improving, reviewing and strengthening our infrastructure, policies and operational controls.
